title: Housing, land, climate resilience, and access to services shape how cities grow
discussion_signal: The post connects adequate housing, spatial transformation, sustainable settlements, climate resilience, and access to services. linked_research_question: How do housing, land, services, and climate exposure combine to shape urban belonging, displacement, and resilience?
